messages.subject_clean: Variables (clinical phenotypes) to be included in metadata during Maaslin
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am running Maaslin using R. I have several metadata to be included: Group (patients or control), D-dimer, CRP, age, gender, sequence reads.
I intended to adjust for age, gender, and sequence reads in each run.

First, I would like to find which bacteria are significantly associated with Group.
So in run #1, I included Group, gender,  age and sequence reads) into the model.

Next, I wanted to find any bacteria significant with the D-dimer and CRP, so I run another two rounds of Maaslin with these metadata
run #2: D-dimer gender,  age, and sequence reads
run #3: CRP, gender,  age and sequence reads

Am I doing it right? Or I shall include all the variables (Group, D-dimer, CRP, age, gender, sequence reads) in the same run(strInputConfig)?

Also, what's the different between
strRandomCovariates
strInputConfig

Thanks if anyone can help
